# Jacques Hauzeur (SoyJacquesHauzeur)

> Jacques Hauzeur (SoyJacquesHauzeur) is a technology educator and mentor for founders and teams — web, marketing, automation and AI. Services are monthly hires priced in USD (chargeable in local currency, e.g. COP); 1:1 sessions are USD $15 per 90-minute class. The site is available in English (/) and Spanish (/es/).

## Pages

- [Home](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/): Who I am and what I do
- [Clients](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/clients.html): Clients and the results they run on
- [1:1](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/sessions.html): Book paid 1:1 sessions (USD $15 / 90 min)
- [Services](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/services.html): The six monthly hires and rates
- [About me](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/#about): My background and approach
- [Blog](https://soyjacqueshauzeur.dev/blog.html): Notes on AI, web, marketing and chatbots
